title: Watercolor/Painted
content: Apply watercolor/painted aesthetic with artistic, handmade feel. Use soft, bleeding edges on elements - no hard lines. Watercolor texture backgrounds with color bleeds. Muted, natural color palette. Brushstroke effects on borders and decorations. Paper texture as base. Flowing, organic shapes. Hand-painted typography style optional. Include splatter and drip accents. Artistic, gallery-like presentation.

variants.simple: Create soft watercolor aesthetic with painted textures, flowing edges, and artistic brushstroke effects.
variants.detailed: Apply watercolor/painted aesthetic with artistic, handmade feel. Use soft, bleeding edges on elements - no hard lines. Watercolor texture backgrounds with color bleeds. Muted, natural color palette. Brushstroke effects on borders and decorations. Paper texture as base. Flowing, organic shapes. Hand-painted typography style optional. Include splatter and drip accents. Artistic, gallery-like presentation.
variants.advanced: Apply watercolor/painted aesthetic with artistic, handmade feel. Edge treatment: soft, irregular edges using CSS mask with watercolor brush SVG, or clip-path with organic curves. Bleed effects: gradient masks fading to transparent, color spreading beyond boundaries. Texture layers: watercolor paper texture (subtle bump/grain), wet-on-wet color bleeds. Color palette: soft, muted tones as if diluted - pale blues, soft greens, blush pinks, diluted ochres. Colors can overlap and mix (use mix-blend-mode: multiply for overlapping colored areas). Brushstroke borders: SVG paths with rough, brushy edges instead of solid borders. Splatter accents: decorative paint splatters and drips (SVG elements) positioned organically. Typography: hand-painted style fonts (Satisfy, Pacifico for scripts), or regular fonts with watercolor texture overlay. Background washes: large areas of diluted color with irregular edges, multiple wash layers. Paint palette decoration: optional circular color swatches as design element. Interactive: color can bleed/spread on hover, paint drip animations. Composition: asymmetric, flowing, following organic movement. Frame: torn paper or deckled edge effect around content areas. Implementation: heavy use of SVG for organic shapes and textures, CSS filters for effects. Performance: optimize SVG assets, consider using CSS gradients for simpler washes. Accessibility: ensure text remains readable over textured backgrounds, provide solid fallback.
